definition: At half-second samples during controlled open play: an off-ball opponent within35m of goal, within24m of the centerline and within35m of the carrier is a dangerous runner. Covered means an outfield defender within5m and no more than0.5m behind the runner toward the attacking goal. Marker/target diagnostics use current mark assignments and are secondary; clearing stale IDs changed their denominator. The full updated engine is compared, not an isolated parameter experiment.
